answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 8802 Country: India Title: Last night in my dream i saw that my grandmother has died .and this is the second time i got this type of dream since last two months can you please help me in this regard .what does this dream indicate?and one more thing i like to inform you that my grandmother is still alive (alhamdulilah). Question: Last night in my dream i saw that my grandmother has died .and this is the second time i got this type of dream since last two months can you please help me in this regard .what does this dream indicate?and one more thing i like to inform you that my grandmother is still alive (alhamdulilah). Answer ID: 8802 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2182/1693=H/1429) It is good dream. The death does not mean demise but it is glad tiding for your grandmother that she will be getting the divine favour of stepping from lower grade to higher ones. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
